2609.29466.title: Direct Message Approximation (DMA): A Consistency-Based Framework for Tractable Approximate Inference on Factor Graphs
2609.29466.paper_summary: Approximate message passing on factor graphs underlies two dominant families of probabilistic inference algorithms: expectation propagation (EP) and variational message passing (VMP). Both methods approximate the marginal at each factor edge, forcing an iterative round-robin schedule, risking negative-precision messages, and, for VMP, collapsing to point estimates at Dirac-delta factors. We introduce Direct Message Approximation (DMA), which approximates factor-to-variable messages directly rather than the marginal. For normalisable factors, we define a consistency condition (requiring exactness when all other incoming messages are Dirac deltas) to guide message construction. We prove a master theorem (proper messages, any graph) bounding marginal KL from message KL, with three structural corollaries: Dirac-input consistency, no EP-style inner-loop iteration, and no negative-precision messages. Further, we prove a complementary $O(1/r^2)$ guarantee for the inherently improper backward message of the product factor, whose closed-form treatment has resisted prior work. As a concrete instantiation, we derive explicit DMA messages for the product and leaky-ReLU factors and assemble a Bayesian neural network (BNN) inference algorithm with one forward/backward sweep per training example and no gradient learning-rate hyperparameter, validating that the structural guarantees translate to predictive uncertainty that widens in data-sparse regions, including under model mismatch.
2609.29466.paper_summary_zh: 近似消息傳遞在因子圖上是兩個主要的概率推斷算法家族的基礎：期望傳播（EP）和變分消息傳遞（VMP）。<lb/>這兩種方法在每個因子邊緣近似邊際，強迫進行迭代的循環排程，冒著負精度消息的風險，對於VMP，則在Dirac-delta因子處崩潰為點估計。<lb/>我們引入直接消息近似（DMA），它直接近似因子到變量的消息，而不是邊際。<lb/>對於可規範的因子，我們定義了一個一致性條件（要求當所有其他傳入消息為Dirac delta時的精確性）來指導消息構建。<lb/>我們證明了一個主定理（正確的消息，任何圖）界定了邊際KL來自消息KL的界限，並有三個結構性推論：Dirac輸入一致性、無EP風格的內部迭代，以及無負精度消息。<lb/>此外，我們證明了一個互補的 $O(1/r^2)$ 保證，針對產品因子的固有不正確的反向消息，其封閉形式處理一直抵抗先前的工作。<lb/>作為一個具體的實例，我們推導了產品和漏鬆ReLU因子的明確DMA消息，並組裝了一個貝葉斯神經網絡（BNN）推斷算法，對每個訓練樣本進行一次前向/反向掃描，且無梯度學習率超參數，驗證了結構性保證轉化為預測不確定性，在數據稀疏區域擴大，包括在模型不匹配的情況下。
